selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The passage teaches that the Qur'an clearly proves Allah’s existence, oneness, qualities, and beautiful Names.

questions.question: What parts of the Qur'an are shown as working together in this testimony?
questions.answer: Its surahs, its verses, its lights and hidden meanings, and its results and effects all support the same truth.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the Qur'an testify to about Allah?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s existence, His unity, His attributes, and His Names.

questions.question: How does the passage show that the Qur'an’s message is strong and trustworthy?
questions.answer: It says many parts of the Qur'an agree with each other and give proof together.

questions.question: Why is the agreement of the surahs and verses important?
questions.answer: It shows the message is not mixed up or weak; it is united and true.

questions.question: From where does the testimony of all believers come, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It comes from the Qur'an’s own testimony and proof.

questions.question: How would you explain this passage to a friend in one sentence?
questions.answer: The Qur'an gives many united proofs that Allah is one and real, and believers follow that clear testimony.

questions.question: How is the testimony of believers described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as endless.

questions.question: What can we infer about the source of sound belief from this passage?
questions.answer: We can infer that sound belief comes from the guidance and proof of the Qur'an.

questions.question: What book is being described in this passage?
questions.answer: The Qur'an is being described.

questions.question: How is the Qur'an described at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as miraculous in every way.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the relationship between the surahs and verses of the Qur'an?
questions.answer: It says they are in harmony and support the same message.

questions.question: Besides surahs and verses, what other things in the Qur'an are said to match each other?
questions.answer: Its lights, mysteries, fruits, and works are also said to match.

questions.question: What four things about Allah are proven by the Qur'an in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence, His oneness, His attributes, and His Names.

questions.question: What does it mean that the Qur'an gives testimony?
questions.answer: It means the Qur'an serves as a witness pointing people to the truth about Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what came from the Qur'an’s testimony?
questions.answer: The never-ending witness of all believers came from it.

questions.question: Why does unity fit better than confusion here?
questions.answer: Because the passage keeps showing that all the Qur'an’s parts agree and point to the same truth.

questions.question: If you had to choose one key message from this passage, what would it be?
questions.answer: The key message is that the Qur'an powerfully and unitedly bears witness to Allah’s truth.

questions.question: Who is the passage mainly pointing people toward?
questions.answer: It is pointing people toward Allah.

questions.question: What is one reason the passage gives for trusting the Qur'an’s message?
questions.answer: It says the different parts of the Qur'an all agree with each other.

questions.question: Name two groups of Qur'anic features mentioned in the passage.
questions.answer: Two groups are its surahs and verses.

questions.question: Name two more Qur'anic features mentioned in the passage.
questions.answer: Two more are its lights and mysteries.

questions.question: Name the last two matching features mentioned in the passage.
questions.answer: The last two are its fruits and works.

questions.question: What does this repeated agreement help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove that Allah exists and that He is one.
